timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I'm Ashley Judd. I start in missing a brand new series on ABC. It's a worldwide espionage
drama connected to a very personal story. The story of a mother searching for her son.
My son disappears in Italy. I go there to find him. I begin using extraordinary skills
and intelligence techniques to track him. My past comes back to haunt me. I'm a former
government agent who had given it all up to be a mom. Now I won't stop until I find my son.
